iconography.realia_identification: High-prow Aegean merchant or war galley with steering oar
iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Galley / Ship.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/na/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 26 (Galley / Ship) depicts High-prow Aegean merchant or war galley with steering oar. Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_041 and Linear A unattested. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/na/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 26): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Galley / Ship) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/na/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
